highest_priority.title: Add structured logging and production-safe error handling across the compare path
highest_priority.reason: Now that Mongo-backed Brain and feedback flows are live, operational failures need structured visibility without leaking user input or credentials.

highest_priority.title: Add structured telemetry for comparison usage, resolution misses, and errors
highest_priority.reason: Usage and resolver-miss signals will guide catalog expansion and UX fixes without guessing from anecdotes.

highest_priority.title: Add MongoDB persistence for submitted comparisons and analytics events
highest_priority.reason: The Atlas environment is now configured, so durable comparison history can move from optional Brain artifacts into the main product path.

highest_priority.title: Create shareable saved comparison pages with stable slugs
highest_priority.reason: Saved comparison pages build directly on persistence and unlock SEO, sharing, and internal-linking work.

highest_priority.title: Improve input UX with guided examples, validation, and unsupported-source messaging
highest_priority.reason: Clearer input guidance reduces resolver misses and makes the narrow V1 catalog feel intentional rather than broken.

selection_policy: Prefer one issue-scoped task per implementer heartbeat. Choose tasks that can be verified locally, committed, and pushed directly to origin/main without force pushes.
